name: Dumbbell Split Squat
summary: A stationary single-leg squat in a split stance that builds quads and glutes and improves balance. It needs very little space at home.
setup: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Take a long step forward and keep both feet pointing straight ahead, with the back heel lifted.
Stand tall with your torso upright and weight spread across the front foot.
execution: Bend both knees and lower your back knee straight down toward the floor.
Keep your front shin fairly vertical, with the front knee tracking over the toes.
Lower until the back knee almost touches the floor or until you reach your comfortable depth.
Press through the front foot to rise, without moving your feet.
cues: Back knee drops to the floor
mistakes: Stance too short: take a longer step so the front heel stays down.
Torso leaning forward: keep chest tall and weights at your sides.
Front knee collapsing inward: push it out over the middle toes.
Balance wobbling: hold a chair or wall with one hand until you are steady.
